entities.summary: Aznakayevo is a town in the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia, located on the Styarlya River, 376 kilometers (234 mi) southeast from Kazan. Population: 34,853 (2010 census); 35,412 (2002 census); 32,171 (1989 Soviet census).
